checkpoint_policy: final trained policies; no fitting, selection or retraining
counterfactual_scope: same starting state, current inflows and daily limits; only the selected reservoir command changes, all other original commands held fixed
interpretation: Same-state restrictions do not prove global physical inevitability; same-day alternatives do not prove an improvement in long-horizon return. Alternatives for different reservoirs/days are evaluated separately, not combined.

classification_definitions.requirement_inactive: The effective service requirement is zero.
classification_definitions.no_violation: The executed service meets its requirement within reward tolerance.
classification_definitions.same_day_policy_alternative: Another available discrete command meets this service from the same saved state; future water value is unassessed.
classification_definitions.discrete_grid_gap: A continuous command meets the service but no configured discrete command does.
classification_definitions.same_state_capacity_limit: The service exceeds its optimistic outlet or turbine/installed capacity bound.
classification_definitions.same_state_water_limit: Releasable water above the current next-state storage floor cannot meet the service even at optimistic maximum head for power.
classification_definitions.same_state_dispatch_limit: The current feasible release ceiling cannot meet the service even at optimistic maximum head for power.
classification_definitions.same_state_head_limit: All continuous current-state power choices fail despite optimistic water, dispatch and hardware bounds.

replay_summary.value_interpretation: saved frozen critic in reward units; realized reward-to-go is observational and does not reconstruct training advantages
